verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that the agent can open and review pull requests with `gh`, which offers a thin form of pre-merge review. There is no documentation of a diff viewer for the developer, and nothing about running tests, CI or other checks. Permission prompts for write and destructive commands are a separate safety control and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented diff inspection UI, the ability to run checks, tests or CI before merging, detail on what PR review covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging

citations.quote: opens and reviews pull requests with `gh`
